Power is STILL down

That makes it I think the worst blackout in Europe since 2006 and maybe longer

We're in Portugal and went to supermarket to get water and food in case power doesn't come back (small chance but already hours now)

Absolute anarchy ala COVID 2020 there

Internet progressively went from 5G to 4G then 3G then 2G then nothing at all progressively, it seems the telecom masts have a battery for just a few hours

Anyway everyone's buying water, food and toilet paper

ATMs are all empty of cash money 

Funny we drove past some guys working on an electricity mast, maybe they didn't get the news it's entire Spain and Portugal? 😂
